t.zh: 先造相机的投影部件。图中 O 是<wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>，虚线标出<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>，f 指向<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>。本实验所有长度共用模型单位，采用正像的虚像平面。固定参照一直保留：每次只改变 X、Z、f 中的一个，先预测，再检查。
t.en: Build the projection part of the camera. O marks the <wiki-ref to="camera-centre"></wiki-ref>, the dashed line the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, and f locates the <wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>. All lengths share model units and the virtual image is upright. Keep the reference in view: change one of X, Z and f at a time, predict, then check.

desc.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>距离 f，输出像点位置 u
desc.en: Takes a point's sideways position X, its distance Z and the plane distance f; gives the image position u (<wiki-ref to="virtual-image-plane"></wiki-ref>)

after.zh: 三个对比都受“<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>经过 O”这一约束，而物点与像点的位置会随距离改变。用<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>联系两段距离，才能把不同场景交给同一块<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>电路；它适用于这里的理想模型，不包含真实镜头的全部影响。
after.en: All three comparisons constrain the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> to pass through O, while scene and image positions vary with distance. Relating the two distances with <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> lets one <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> circuit handle different scenes. It applies to this ideal model, without all the effects of a real lens.

brief.zh: 参照 X=2、Z=4、f=2，像点 u=1。按步骤观察哪一个量变了，输入你预测的 u，再检查光路。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
brief.en: Reference: X=2, Z=4, f=2, image u=1. At each step inspect the changed quantity, enter your predicted u, then check the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 先比较场景与参照的数值；如果只把物点移得更远，像点应当离<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>更远，还是更近？
hint.en: Compare trial and reference measurements first. If only the scene point moves farther away, should its image move farther from the axis or nearer? (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 需要几何依据时，点开<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>，再比较物点与像点各自相对于 O 的三角形。
hint.en: For the geometric relation, open <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref> and compare the scene and image triangles about O.

note.zh: X 从 2 变成 4；Z、f 不变。
note.en: X changes from 2 to 4; Z and f stay fixed.

note.zh: Z 从 4 变成 8；X、f 恢复参照值。
note.en: Z changes from 4 to 8; X and f return to the reference.

note.zh: f 从 2 变成 4；X、Z 恢复参照值。
note.en: f changes from 2 to 4; X and Z return to the reference.

why.zh: X 已变而 Z、f 未变，参照的像点不能直接照抄。检查后比较两条光路。
why.en: X changed while Z and f did not; do not copy the reference image point. Compare the two rays after checking.

t.zh: 现在把三个对照中发现的关系合成一块电路。输入可独立变化，必须同时通过正、负位置和不同深度的测试。使用乘法与除法元件。
t.en: Combine the three comparisons into one circuit. Inputs vary independently: handle positive and negative positions and different depths using multiplication and division parts.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

hint.zh: 先决定 X 在同一深度下怎样缩放，再比较 Z 和 f 各改变哪一段距离。
hint.en: First decide how X is scaled at one depth, then compare which distance changes with Z and f.

hint.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>的比例关系；需要的是能随三个输入一起变化的关系，而不是固定倍数。
hint.en: Revisit the proportion in <wiki-ref to="similar-triangles"></wiki-ref>; the scale must respond to all three inputs rather than stay fixed.
